description_en: Queries the cross-account authorization information of an IPsec-VPN connection
description_zh: 调用DescribeVpnCrossAccountAuthorizations接口查询IPsec连接的跨账号授权信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-cross-account-authorizations --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-connection-id vco-p0w2jpkhi2eeop6q60000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpnCrossAccountAuthorizations

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection
parameters.name: vpn_connection_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when paging is used. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。默认值：10。取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may differ for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

CrossAccountAuthorizations.description_en: The list of cross-account authorization information of the IPsec-VPN connection
CrossAccountAuthorizations.description_zh: IPsec连接跨账号授权信息列表

items.description_en: The cross-account authorization information of the IPsec-VPN connection

AliUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the IPsec-VPN connection
AliUid.description_zh: IPsec连接所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

BindInstance.description_en: The instance ID of the CEN instance to which the IPsec-VPN connection authorization is granted
BindInstance.description_zh: IPsec连接授权的云企业网实例ID

BindProduct.description_en:
The type of resource to which the IPsec-VPN connection is authorized.

The value is CEN only, which indicates that the IPsec-VPN connection is authorized to a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance that belongs to another Alibaba Cloud account. The IPsec-VPN connection can be attached to a transit router instance under the cross-account CEN instance
BindProduct.description_zh:
IPsec连接授权的资源类型。

仅取值：CEN，表示IPsec连接向跨账号的云企业网实例授权，IPsec连接可被绑定至跨账号云企业网实例下的转发路由器实例

BindUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the IPsec-VPN connection is authorized
BindUid.description_zh: IPsec连接授权的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

CreationTime.description_en:
The timestamp when the cross-account authorization was created for the IPsec-VPN connection.

The timestamp is in the UNIX format and represents the total number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC to the time when the cross-account authorization was created
CreationTime.description_zh:
IPsec连接创建跨账号授权的时间戳。

时间戳的格式采用Unix时间戳，表示从格林威治时间1970年01月01日00时00分00秒至创建跨账号授权时的总时长

VpnConnectionId.description_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the list

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page when paging is used
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
